verdict.rationale: The evidence shows outbound notifications only: an email when registration succeeds, and a notice with 5 days to correct any nonconformities. Nothing documents a way for a founder to look up the status of a filing or application on the service's public pages. Email notification is an adjacent behavior, not a status-lookup capability.

support.subject: As a founder, I can look up the status of my filing, application, or case from the service's public pages
